source_text: Ji gato gum do Paulus, gato Yefun Allah iwa bes gum yerasul wa ben Yesus Kristus bi suk-i, si Sostenes, men ka we anato krom surat ré wa nin.
reference_text_ind: Dari Paulus, yang oleh kehendak Allah dipanggil menjadi rasul Kristus Yesus, dan dari Sostenes, saudara kita
reference_text_eng: From Paul, who by the will of God was called to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Sosthenes our brother,
